log.title: Shipping & Transport Coordination
log.incoterms: Incoterms are selected according to the product, origin, destination, logistics feasibility and contractual agreement. Shipment milestones and documentation requirements are coordinated once the commercial structure is confirmed.
log.ports: Loading points and routes vary by product, origin and current availability.
log.ports.p: Depending on the product and route, supply may move by bulk vessel, container, truck or other suitable transport mode. Packing can include bulk, bags or Big Bags subject to confirmed supply and buyer requirements.
log.compliance.p: Documentation requirements are reviewed according to the product, origin, destination and transaction structure. Typical records may include Certificate of Origin, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, COA and other product- or shipment-specific documents.
log.lead: Euro Agri Trading supports fertilizer transaction execution by coordinating suitable road and maritime transport requirements through independent logistics and transport providers. Each solution is assessed case by case according to the cargo, packing, quantity, route, Incoterm, delivery window and operational availability.
log.network: Through a developing network of independent logistics and transport providers across Europe and selected maritime routes.
log.road.p: Coordination of LTL and FTL road freight across the Czech Republic and Europe, including palletised and Big Bag cargo. Specialised or heavy transport is assessed where required.
log.maritime.p: Coordination support for suitable maritime options, including bulk or containerised cargo and Ship-to-Ship (STS) transfer or lightering where commercially and operationally appropriate.
log.delivery.p: Alignment of loading points, routes, packing, shipment milestones, delivery requirements and communication between the supplier, buyer and selected independent logistics provider.
log.disclaimer: References to logistics or transport coordination describe facilitation through independent providers. Euro Agri Trading does not itself perform carriage, operate trucks or vessels, or represent a transport fleet or shipping line.
how.title: How We Work — Sourcing, Risk Control & Execution
how.lead: Euro Agri Trading s.r.o. connects qualified buyers with suitable fertilizer supply sources and coordinates the transaction in stages. We assess current availability and commercial feasibility first, then expand product, counterparty, documentation and payment verification as the deal advances.
how.policyLead: Our process is designed to focus verification effort where it matters and keep commercially viable transactions moving:
how.p1: Current availability, quantity, commercial basis and delivery feasibility are assessed first
how.p2: Counterparty, product and payment verification are expanded as the transaction advances
how.p3: Independent inspection at loading: SGS / Intertek / Bureau Veritas when required or agreed
how.p4: Shipment-specific documentation is aligned according to the product, destination and contractual requirements
how.p5: Sensitive counterparty and shipment information is shared according to transaction stage and business need
how.conf.title: Confidentiality, Client Protection & Engagement
how.conf.text: We protect introduced business relationships and share counterparty details only when commercially necessary. Where appropriate, the engagement structure, intermediary role, commission or margin basis, client protection and repeat-transaction protection are confirmed in writing before sensitive counterparty information is disclosed.
how.noteText: Euro Agri Trading's role is confirmed for each transaction. In intermediary transactions, Euro Agri may act as an Introducer, Intermediary or Trade Coordinator while the buyer and seller remain the principal contracting parties. Other commercial structures may be used when operationally and commercially appropriate.

about.title: About Euro Agri Trading
about.p1: Euro Agri Trading s.r.o. is a Czech Republic-based fertilizer sourcing and trade coordination company supporting European buyers and international supply partners.
about.pricing: We work with an established multi-origin network that includes qualified and verified fertilizer suppliers, matching real RFQs with suitable supply options based on specification, quantity, timing, origin, logistics and commercial feasibility.
about.p2: Our role includes supplier qualification, RFQ coordination, product and shipment documentation review, Incoterms and logistics alignment, and independent inspection coordination when required.
about.p3: We focus on executable transactions, clear commercial communication, counterparty risk reduction and long-term protected business relationships.
about.logistics: Where a transaction requires transport support, Euro Agri may coordinate road, maritime or specialised logistics through independent providers, subject to route, cargo, timing and availability.
about.note: Transaction structure is confirmed case-by-case. Euro Agri Trading may act as a sourcing partner, introducer, intermediary or trade coordinator, with contracting roles and commercial responsibilities defined according to each transaction.
